example.en: We study English every day. So of course we should know something about England.
example.cn: 我们每天都学习英语，因此我们当然应该知道一些有关英国的事。

cn: 干劲， 精力； 能量； 能源
enDef: power that is used to provide heat, operate machines etc

example.en: The water is heated using energy from the sun.
example.cn: 水是利用太阳能加热的。

enDef: the number

example.en: She was sent to jail for eleven months.
example.cn: 她被判入狱11个月。

enDef: a small piece of rubber that you use to remove pencil or pen marks from paper

example.en: Yes, I have your eraser, too.
example.cn: 是的，我还拿了你的橡皮。

cn: 例子， 实例； 榜样， 楷模
enDef: a specific fact, idea, person, or thing that is used to explain or support a general idea, or to show what is typical of a larger group

example.en: Many countries, for example Mexico and Japan, have a lot of earthquakes.
example.cn: 许多国家，例如墨西哥和日本，经常发生地震。

enDef: a round object with a hard surface, that contains a baby bird, snake, insect etc and which is produced by a female bird, snake, insect etc

example.en: Blackbirds lay their eggs in March.
example.cn: 乌鸫在3月产蛋。

enDef: to tell or show what you are feeling or thinking by using words, looks, or actions

example.en: Parents have expressed their concerns about their children’s safety.
example.cn: 父母对自己孩子的安全表示忧虑。

enDef: having nothing inside

example.en: an empty box
example.cn: 空盒子

enDef: relating to Europe or its people

example.en: European languages
example.cn: 欧洲的语言

enDef: to try using various ideas, methods etc to find out how good or effective they are

example.en: The teacher provided some different materials and left the children to experiment.
example.cn: 老师提供了几种不同的材料让孩子们试验。

enDef: the continent that is north of the Mediterranean and goes as far east as the Ural Mountains in Russia

example.en: eastern Europe
example.cn: 东欧

cn: 在任何时候， 从来； 曾经
enDef: a word meaning at any time; used mostly in questions, negatives, comparisons, or sentences with ‘if’

example.en: Nothing ever seems to upset him.
example.cn: 似乎从来没有什么事情会使他烦恼。

enDef: used to emphasize something that is unexpected or surprising in what you are saying

example.en: Most companies have suffered a drop in their profits, even very large companies.
example.cn: 大多数公司的利润都出现下滑，甚至连很大的公司也不例外。

enDef: the part of an object that is furthest from its centre

example.en: Put the eggs in the centre of the dish, with the vegetables and herbs around the edge.
example.cn: 把鸡蛋放在盘子中间，盘边一圈放些蔬菜和香草。

cn: 检查；调查； 检测；考试
enDef: to look at something carefully and thoroughly because you want to find out more about it

example.en: A team of divers was sent down to examine the wreck.
example.cn: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

cn: 每人， 人人， 各人
enDef: every person

example.en: If everyone is ready, I’ll begin.
example.cn: 如果大家都准备好了，我就开始。

enDef: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb

example.en: You’re going to have to work extra hard to pass the exam.
example.cn: 你要格外用功才能通过考试。

enDef: a show of paintings, photographs, or other objects that people can go to see

example.en: ...an exhibition of expressionist art.
example.cn: …一场印象主义艺术展览会。

enDef: relating to England or its people

example.en: the English countryside
example.cn: 英格兰乡村

cn: 结束；目标；尽头；末端；死亡
enDef: a situation in which something is finished or no longer exists

example.en: At last it seemed the war might be coming to an end.
example.cn: 终于战争似乎即将结束。

enDef: coming after seven other things in a series

example.en: in the eighth century
example.cn: 在8世纪

enDef: Each is also an adverb

example.en: The children were given one each, handed to them or placed on their plates.
example.cn: 孩子们每人给一个，递给他们或者放在他们的盘子里。

enDef: someone whose job is to design or build roads, bridges, machines etc

example.en: He trained as a civil engineer (= one who designs and builds roads, bridges etc ).
example.cn: 他接受过土木工程师培训。

cn: 娱乐； 表演会； 招待， 款待
enDef: when you entertain someone at home, or for business

example.en: the entertainment of friends
example.cn: 招待朋友

cn: 原谅， 宽恕； 使免除； 为…辩解， 作为开脱…的理由
enDef: to forgive someone for doing something that is not seriously wrong, such as being rude or careless

example.en: I’ll excuse you this time, but don’t be late again.
example.cn: 这次我原谅你，但别再迟到了。

enDef: to leave a place when someone is trying to catch you or stop you, or when there is a dangerous situation

example.en: He broke down the locked door and escaped.
example.cn: 他砸开上锁的门，逃走了。

enDef: in or to every place

example.en: I’ve looked everywhere but I can’t find the map.
example.cn: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

enDef: to not include something

example.en: They were all there except me.
example.cn: 除了我以外他们都在那里。

enDef: in or from the east of a country or area

example.en: the eastern shore of the island
example.cn: 岛的东岸

cn: 努力， 尝试； 努力的成果， 成就
enDef: the physical or mental energy that is needed to do something

example.en: Lou lifted the box easily, without using much effort.
example.cn: 卢没费多大力气就把箱子搬了起来。

cn: 在开始阶段， 在初期； 提前， 提早
enDef: before the usual, arranged, or expected time

example.en: We arrived early.
example.cn: 我们提早到了。

cn: 电的；电动的；发电的；导电的；令人震惊的
enDef: needing electricity to work, produced by electricity, or used for carrying electricity

example.en: an electric blanket
example.cn: 电热毯

enDef: the air, water, and land on Earth, which is affected by man’s activities

example.en: Some of these chemicals are very damaging to the environment.
example.cn: 这些化学品中有些对环境非常有害。

enDef: someone who hates you and wants to harm you

example.en: She’s a dangerous enemy to have.
example.cn: 与她为敌很危险。

enDef: one of the organs on either side of your head that you hear with

example.en: She tucked her hair behind her ears.
example.cn: 她把头发拢到耳朵背后。

cn: 地球；地表，陆地；土地，土壤；尘事，俗事；兽穴
enDef: the planet that we live on

example.en: the planet Earth
example.cn: 地球

enDef: the direction from which the sun rises, and which is on the right if you are facing north

example.en: Which way is east?
example.cn: 哪边是东？

enDef: not difficult to do, and not needing much effort

example.en: The test was easy.
example.cn: 考试很容易。

enDef: the process of teaching and learning, usually at school, college, or university

example.en: She also hopes her children will get a good education.
example.cn: 她也希望她的孩子可以受到良好的教育。

cn: 进入； 参加， 加入
enDef: to start to take part in an activity, or become involved in a situation

example.en: He entered the election as the clear favourite.
example.cn: 他参加竞选时显然最有希望获胜。

enDef: the number 8

example.en: It’s only eight days till Christmas.
example.cn: 还有8天就到圣诞节了。

enDef: the number 18

example.en: At least eighteen bullets were fired.
example.cn: 至少射出了18颗子弹。

enDef: the number 80

example.en: The band was incredibly successful in the eighties.
example.cn: 这支乐队在80年代红透半边天。

cn: 两者之中任一的；两者之中每一的

enDef: to be older than someone else

example.en: a meeting of the village elders
example.cn: 村里长辈们的集会

enDef: a very large grey animal with four legs, two tusks(= long curved teeth ) and a trunk(= long nose ) that it can use to pick things up

example.en: Tom: No.Although 75% of its raw materials is elephant dung, it is light delicate fragrance instead of stink. This is due to its special fabrication technology.
example.cn: 不，尽管这种纸里75％的原料都是大象的粪便，但它不但不臭，反而有一种淡淡的清香，这是源于它的特殊的制造工艺。

enDef: besides or in addition to someone or something

example.en: There’s something else I’d like to talk about as well.
example.cn: 我还有其他事情要谈一谈。

enDef: to give someone the courage or confidence to do something

example.en: I want to thank everyone who has encouraged and supported me.
example.cn: 我要感谢每一位鼓励和支持过我的人。

cn: 欣赏，享受；喜爱；使过得快活
enDef: If you enjoy something such as a right, benefit, or privilege, you have it

example.en: The average German will enjoy 40 days' paid holiday this year.
example.cn: 德国人今年平均将享有40天带薪假期。

enDef: to the degree that is necessary or wanted

example.en: Are the carrots cooked enough?
example.cn: 胡萝卜煮熟了吗？

enDef: used to emphasize that something is more important or happens more with one particular thing than with others

example.en: I never liked long walks, especially in winter.
example.cn: 我向来不喜欢长距离散步，尤其在冬天。

cn: 晚上；傍晚；（联欢性的）晚会；后期
enDef: the early part of the night between the end of the day and the time you go to bed

example.en: I do most of my studying in the evening.
example.cn: 我学习大都在晚上。

enDef: Every is also an adjective

example.en: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
example.cn: 他说的每句话都会被细查。

enDef: everyone
ordinary, usual, or happening every day

example.en: the problems of everyday life
example.cn: 日常生活中的问题

cn: 每件事物；最重要的东西；（有关的）一切；万事
enDef: each thing or all things

example.en: Everything was covered in a thick layer of dust.
example.cn: 所有东西上面都蒙着厚厚一层灰。

enDef: extremely good or of very high quality

example.en: an excellent suggestion
example.cn: 极好的建议

enDef: to make someone feel happy, interested, or eager

example.en: His playing is technically brilliant, but it doesn’t excite me.
example.cn: 他的演奏技巧娴熟，但并不让我激动。

cn: 经历， 体验， 感受
enDef: if you experience a problem, event, or situation, it happens to you or affects you

example.en: Children need to experience things for themselves in order to learn from them.
example.cn: 儿童需要亲身经历事情以便从中学习。

cn: 运动；练习；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼
enDef: physical activities that you do in order to stay healthy and become stronger

example.en: Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
example.cn: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

enDef: to think that something will happen because it seems likely or has been planned

example.en: He will be hard to beat. I fully expect (= am completely sure about ) that and I’m ready.
example.cn: 他很难击败。我确信这一点，不过我准备好了。

enDef: costing a lot of money

example.en: the most expensive restaurant in town
example.cn: 城里最贵的餐馆

enDef: to tell someone about something in a way that is clear or easy to understand

example.en: He carefully explained the procedure.
example.cn: 他仔细解释了程序。

cn: 眼睛；视力；眼光；见解，观点
enDef: one of the two parts of the body that you use to see with

example.en: He’s got beautiful eyes.
example.cn: 他有一双漂亮的眼睛。

cn: 尴尬的， 为难的； 陷入困境的， 窘迫的
enDef: feeling uncomfortable or nervous and worrying about what people think of you, for example because you have made a silly mistake, or because you have to talk or sing in public

example.en: Lori gets embarrassed if we ask her to sing.
example.cn: 我们要是请洛丽唱歌，她就会难为情。

enDef: the tools, machines etc that you need to do a particular job or activity

example.en: a shop selling camping equipment
example.cn: 出售露营装备的商店

enDef: a machine that takes people and goods from one level to another in a building

example.en: We’ll have to take the elevator.
example.cn: 我们只好坐电梯了。

enDef: to put food in your mouth and chew and swallow it

example.en: Felix chatted cheerfully as he ate.
example.cn: 费利克斯一边吃一边兴奋地聊天。

cn: 教育； 培养， 训练
enDef: to teach a child at a school, college, or university

example.en: The Ormerod School educates handicapped children.
example.cn: 奥默罗德学校的教育对象为残疾儿童。

cn: 考试； 试题； 检查， 调查
enDef: a spoken or written test of knowledge, especially an important one

example.en: At the end of each level, there’s an exam.
example.cn: 在每一级别结束时都有一次考试。

enDef: to replace one thing with another

example.en: We exchanged addresses.
example.cn: 我们交换了地址。

enDef: a thin paper cover in which you put and send a letter

example.en: envelopes and stamps
example.cn: 信封和邮票

enDef: one of eleven equal parts of something

example.en: On the eleventh day of Christmas.
example.cn: 在圣诞节的第十一天。

cn: 基本的， 基础的； 初级的， 小学的
enDef: simple or basic

example.en: the elementary principles of justice and democracy
example.cn: 正义和民主的基本信条

enDef: a set of moving stairs that take people to different levels in a building

example.en: Take the escalator to the third floor and it's the last office on the left.
example.cn: 乘电梯到4楼，左边最后的那个办公室就是。

enDef: without problems or difficulties

example.en: They won quite easily.
example.cn: 他们赢得相当轻松。

cn: 建立， 设立； 确定， 证实
enDef: to start a company, organization, system, etc that is intended to exist or continue for a long time

example.en: The city of Boerne was established by German settlers in the 1840s.
example.cn: 博恩市是德国移民于19世纪40年代建立的。

cn: 短文， 文章； 随笔， 散文
enDef: a short piece of writing about a particular subject by a student as part of a course of study

example.en: We asked Jason to write an essay about his hometown.
example.cn: 我们让杰森写一篇关于他家乡的短文。

enDef: to push someone with your elbows, especially in order to move past them

example.en: She pushed through the crowd, elbowing people out of the way.
example.cn: 她用手肘把人们推开，从人群中挤了出来。

example.en: I took the elevator to the eighteenth floor.
example.cn: 我坐电梯上了第十八层。

cn: 感情； 激情； 情绪
enDef: a strong human feeling such as love, hate, or anger

example.en: Her voice was full of emotion.
example.cn: 她的声音充满了激情。

enDef: the formal rules for polite behaviour in society or in a particular group

example.en: strict rules of professional etiquette
example.cn: 严格的行规

enDef: a sudden shaking of the earth’s surface that often causes a lot of damage

example.en: An earthquake measuring 6.1 on the Richter scale struck southern California on June 28.
example.cn: 6月28日加州南部地区发生了里氏6.1级地震。

enDef: the reasons you give for why something happened or why you did something

example.en: She told the court she would give a full explanation of the prosecution's decision on Monday.
example.cn: 她告诉法庭她将在星期一就控方的决定做出详尽的解释。

cn: 赚，赚得；获得，挣得；使得到；博得
enDef: to receive a particular amount of money for the work that you do

example.en: He earns nearly £20,000 a year.
example.cn: 他每年挣近20,000英镑。

enDef: to choose someone for an official position by voting

example.en: the country’s first democratically elected government
example.cn: 该国第一个民主选举产生的政府

enDef: if you enlarge something, or if it enlarges, it increases in size or scale

example.en: an operation to enlarge her breasts
example.cn: 她的丰胸手术

enDef: to sell goods to another country

example.en: Italian food has been exported all over the world.
example.cn: 意大利食品已传遍世界。

enDef: to burst, or to make something burst, into small pieces, usually with a loud noise and in a way that causes damage

example.en: The device was thrown at an army patrol but failed to explode.
example.cn: 炸弹投向了陆军巡逻队，但没有爆炸。

cn: 进展， 演变， 进化
enDef: the scientific idea that plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time

example.en: the theory of evolution
example.cn: 进化论

enDef: to show something that is usually covered or hidden

example.en: He lifted his T-shirt to expose a jagged scar across his chest.
example.cn: 他撩起T恤衫，露出横贯胸部的锯齿状伤疤。

enDef: used when you want to emphasize that you mean all of a group, period of time, amount etc

example.en: It was the worst day in my entire life.
example.cn: 那是我一生中最糟糕的一天。

example.en: You can contact us by e-mail.
example.cn: 你可以通过电子邮件跟我们联系。

enDef: the feeling of wanting something that someone else has

example.en: She could see that all the other girls were green with envy(= feeling a lot of envy ).
example.cn: 她看得出其他女孩都很眼红。

enDef: having or needing a lot of energy or determination

example.en: an energetic man
example.cn: 精力旺盛的男子

enDef: a change that is caused by an event, action etc

example.en: the long-term effects of the drug
example.cn: 这种毒品的长期影响

enDef: relating to electricity

example.en: The fire was caused by an electrical fault.
example.cn: 大火是电力故障引起的。

enDef: after a long time, or after a lot of things have happened

example.en: He eventually escaped and made his way back to England.
example.cn: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

enDef: completely correct in every detail

example.en: Police are still investigating the exact cause of the accident.
example.cn: 警方还在调查这起事故的确切原因。

cn: 紧急情况；突发事件；非常时刻
enDef: an unexpected and dangerous situation that must be dealt with immediately

example.en: Lifeguards are trained to deal with emergencies.
example.cn: 救生员接受过应对紧急情况的训练。

enDef: easy to see, notice, or understand

example.en: Bob ate his lunch with evident enjoyment.
example.cn: 显然鲍勃吃午饭吃得津津有味。

enDef: to discuss or think about something carefully

example.en: Management need to explore ways of improving office security.
example.cn: 管理层需要探讨如何加强办事处的安全措施。

enDef: the way in which plants, animals, and people are related to each other and to their environment, or the scientific study of this

example.en: the natural ecology of the Earth
example.cn: 地球的自然生态

enDef: the same in size, number, amount, value etc as something else

example.en: Our constitution states that all men are equal.
example.cn: 我们的宪法规定人人平等。

enDef: if a company, business etc expands, or if someone expands it, they open new shops, factories etc

example.en: The computer industry has expanded greatly over the last decade.
example.cn: 计算机行业在过去十年间大大地发展起来。

enDef: a company, organization, or business

example.en: commercial enterprises such as banks and food manufacturers
example.cn: 银行和食品制造厂等商业企业

enDef: the person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine, or part of a newspaper or magazine, and decides what should be included in it

example.en: the editor of a book of essays on modern poetry
example.cn: 现代诗歌论文集的编者

enDef: to treat someone unfairly by asking them to do things for you, but giving them very little in return – used to show disapproval

example.en: Homeworkers can easily be exploited by employers.
example.cn: 在家工作的人容易被雇主剥削。

cn: 明确的；清楚的；直率的；详述的
enDef: expressed in a way that is very clear and direct

example.en: The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
example.cn: 这个对比再清楚不过了。

cn: 无止境的； 没完没了的
enDef: very large in amount, size, or number

example.en: an endless stream of visitors
example.cn: 川流不息的游客

enDef: what you think or hope will happen

example.en: Having raised expectations (= made people more hopeful ), he went on to help only a few people.
example.cn: 他唤起了大家的希望，但接着只是帮助了几个人。

enDef: towards the east

example.en: The ship continued sailing eastwards.
example.cn: 船继续向东行驶。

cn: 鼓励， 支持， 促进； 起激励作用的事物
enDef: when you encourage someone or something, or the things that encourage them

example.en: With encouragement, Sally is starting to play with the other children.
example.cn: 萨莉受到了鼓励，开始和其他孩子玩起来。

cn: 极端的；极度的；偏激的；尽头的
enDef: very great in degree

example.en: Extreme poverty still exists in many rural areas.
example.cn: 许多农村地区仍处于赤贫状态。

enDef: to judge how good, useful, or successful something is

example.en: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
example.cn: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

enDef: feeling or showing a lot of interest and excitement about something

example.en: an enthusiastic supporter of reform
example.cn: 改革的热心支持者

enDef: very unusual or surprising

example.en: It took an extraordinary amount of work.
example.cn: 这费了相当多的功夫。

cn: 平等， 同等， 均等
enDef: a situation in which people have the same rights, advantages etc

example.en: ...equality of the sexes.
example.cn: …性别平等。

cn: 表情； 表达法， 表达方式
enDef: something you say, write, or do that shows what you think or feel

example.en: Student leaders are demanding greater freedom of expression (= the right to say what you think without being punished ).
example.cn: 学生领袖要求得到更多的言论自由。

enDef: to pay someone to work for you

example.en: The factory employs over 2,000 people.
example.cn: 这家工厂雇用了2,000多名员工。

enDef: a large vegetable with smooth purple skin

example.en: I have eggplant and tomatoes.
example.cn: 我吃茄子和西红柿。

enDef: something enjoyable gives you pleasure

example.en: Games can make learning more enjoyable.
example.cn: 游戏可以寓教于乐。

enDef: the man who is the ruler of an empire

example.en: I am napoleon, I am emperor… burned it!
example.cn: 我就是拿破仑，我就是皇帝…烧掉它！

enDef: an additional period of time allowed for something

example.en: Donald’s been given an extension to finish his thesis.
example.cn: 唐纳德获准延期完成他的论文。

example.en: They caravaned through Egypt.
example.cn: 他们结队在埃及坐大篷车旅行。

enDef: very keen and excited about something that is going to happen or about something you want to do

example.en: He’s a bright kid and eager to learn.
example.cn: 他是个聪明的孩子，热爱学习。

cn: 事件， 大事； 竞赛
enDef: something that happens, especially something important, interesting or unusual

example.en: one of the most important events in the history of mankind
example.cn: 人类历史上最重大的事件之一

enDef: to a very great degree

example.en: Earthquakes are extremely difficult to predict.
example.cn: 地震非常难以预测。

enDef: if something unpleasant eases, or if you ease it, it gradually improves or becomes less

example.en: measures to ease congestion in the city
example.cn: 改善城市拥堵状况的措施

enDef: a Christian holy day in March or April when Christians remember the death of Christ and his return to life

example.en: on Easter Sunday
example.cn: 在复活节星期日

enDef: the form that a book, newspaper, magazine etc is produced in

example.en: a paperback edition
example.cn: 平装本

cn: 教育家；教育工作者；教师
enDef: a teacher or someone involved in the process of educating people

example.en: What more could an educator hope for than a student's desire to learn.
example.cn: 除了学生的学习兴趣，教育者们别无所求。

enDef: electronic equipment, such as computers and televisions, uses electricity that has passed through computer chips, transistors etc

example.en: electronic games
example.cn: 电子游戏

enDef: relating to Egypt or its people

example.en: ...the Egyptian pharaoh.
example.cn: ...古埃及法老。

cn: 电力；电流；强烈的紧张情绪
enDef: the power that is carried by wires, cables etc, and is used to provide light or heat, to make machines work etc

example.en: The farm was very isolated, but it had electricity.
example.cn: 那个农场非常偏远，但有电力供应。

cn: 高雅的，优雅的；讲究的；简炼的；简洁的
enDef: beautiful, attractive, or graceful

example.en: a tall, elegant young woman
example.cn: 身材高挑、举止优雅的年轻女子

cn: 使局促不安；使困窘；阻碍
enDef: to make someone feel ashamed, nervous, or uncomfortable, especially in front of other people

example.en: He didn’t want to embarrass her by asking questions.
example.cn: 他不想提问让她尴尬。

cn: 大使馆；大使馆全体人员
enDef: a group of officials who represent their government in a foreign country, or the building they work in

example.en: the American Embassy in Paris
example.cn: 美国驻巴黎大使馆

enDef: a group of countries that are all controlled by one ruler or government

example.en: the Roman empire
example.cn: 罗马帝国

enDef: a mistake

example.en: an error message
example.cn: 出错信息

enDef: the way that a story, film, activity etc finishes

example.en: Verbal nouns have the ending -ing.
example.cn: 动名词以-ing结尾。

cn: 引擎，发动机；机车，火车头；工具
enDef: the part of a vehicle that produces power to make it move

example.en: Is the engine running smoothly?
example.cn: 发动机运转平稳吗？

enDef: a door, gate etc that you go through to enter a place

example.en: the station entrance
example.cn: 车站的入口处

cn: 进入；入口；条目；登记；报关手续；对土地的侵占
enDef: the act of going into something

example.en: There was no sign of a forced entry.
example.cn: 没有强行闯入的迹象。

enDef: to provide a person or place with the things that are needed for a particular kind of activity or work

example.en: They try to equip their vehicles with gadgets to deal with every possible contingency.
example.cn: 他们尽量给他们的车辆配备各种小装置以应付任何可能的突发状况。

enDef: if fighting, violence, noise etc erupts, it starts suddenly

example.en: Violence erupted after police shot a student during the demonstration.
example.cn: 警察向示威人群中的一名学生开枪，暴乱随之发生。

enDef: facts or signs that show clearly that something exists or is true

example.en: Murrow’s evidence was enough to convict Hayes of murder.
example.cn: 默罗的证词足以证明海斯犯了谋杀罪。

cn: 恰好地；正是；精确地；正确地
enDef: used when emphasizing that something is no more and no less than a number or amount, or is completely correct in every detail

example.en: It’s exactly half past five.
example.cn: 一分不差，正好5点半。

cn: 存在；生存；生活；继续存在
enDef: to happen or be present in a particular situation or place

example.en: The custom of arranged marriages still exists in many countries.
example.cn: 许多国家仍存在包办婚姻的习俗。

cn: 存在，实在；生存，生活；存在物，实在物
enDef: the state of existing

example.en: Scientists have many theories about how the universe first came into existence (= started to exist ).
example.cn: 关于宇宙的起源，科学家有多种理论。

enDef: a door or space through which you can leave a public room, building etc

example.en: We made for the nearest exit.
example.cn: 我们走向最近的出口。

enDef: Expense is the money that something costs you or that you need to spend in order to do something

example.en: He's bought a big TV at vast expense so that everyone can see properly.
example.cn: 他花了很多钱买了台大电视，这样人人都可以看清楚了。

enDef: having a special skill or special knowledge of a subject

example.en: He cast his expert eye on the gardener’s work.
example.cn: 他用内行的眼光看了看园丁干的活。

cn: 探险家；勘探者；探测器；[医]探针
enDef: someone who travels through an unknown area to find out about it

example.en: ...the travels of Columbus, Magellan, and many other explorers.
example.cn: …哥伦布、麦哲伦和许多其他探险家的旅行。

enDef: your ability to see

example.en: He had a problem with his eyesight.
example.cn: 他的视力有问题。

enDef: someone who has seen something such as a crime happen, and is able to describe it afterwards

example.en: One eyewitness said he saw her talking to a man in a blue car.
example.cn: 一名目击者说他看见她在跟一个坐在蓝色汽车里的男子说话。

enDef: Eastward or eastwards means toward the east

example.en: A powerful snow storm is moving eastward.
example.cn: 一场猛烈的暴风雪正向东转移。

cn: 编辑的，主笔的，编者的；社论的，社论式的
enDef: relating to the preparation of a newspaper, book, television programme etc for printing or broadcasting

example.en: an editorial assistant
example.cn: 编辑助理

example.en: They thought she would be popular, warm and easygoing, but not demanding and difficult.
example.cn: 他们认为她会是受人欢迎的，温情的，随和的，而非挑三拣四难以追求的。

example.en: This oil lubricates efficiently.
example.cn: 这油能有效地起润滑作用。

enDef: to completely get rid of something that is unnecessary or unwanted

example.en: a ruthless dictator who eliminated all his rivals
example.cn: 铲除所有异己的残酷独裁者

enDef: to put your arms around someone and hold them in a friendly or loving way

example.en: Jack warmly embraced his son.
example.cn: 杰克热情拥抱他的儿子。

enDef: when something begins to be known or noticed

example.en: The day after that, the emergence of a new competitor.
example.cn: 今后的每一天都可能出现新的竞争对手。

enDef: a gas or other substance that is sent into the air

example.en: Britain agreed to cut emissions of nitrogen oxide from power stations.
example.cn: 英国同意减少发电站氮氧化物的排放量。

enDef: to send out gas, heat, light, sound etc

example.en: The kettle emitted a shrill whistle.
example.cn: 水壶发出了刺耳的鸣笛声。

cn: 情绪的；容易激动的；感动人的
enDef: relating to your feelings or how you control them

example.en: She provided emotional support at a very distressing time for me.
example.cn: 在我非常痛苦的时候，她是我的情感支柱。

enDef: to say something in a strong way

example.en: The report emphasizes the importance of improving safety standards.
example.cn: 报告强调了改进安全标准的重要性。

enDef: the ability to continue doing something difficult or painful over a long period of time

example.en: She was pushed beyond her powers of endurance.
example.cn: 她被逼得忍无可忍。

enDef: to be in a difficult or painful situation for a long time without complaining

example.en: It seemed impossible that anyone could endure such pain.
example.cn: 似乎谁都不可能忍受这样的疼痛。

enDef: to attract someone’s attention and keep them interested

example.en: I have never engaged in drug trafficking.
example.cn: 我从来没有从事过贩毒。

enDef: an agreement between two people to marry, or the period of time they are engaged

example.en: Their engagement was announced in the paper.
example.cn: 他们订婚的消息在报上公布了。

enDef: to improve something

example.en: Good lighting will enhance any room.
example.cn: 良好的照明能给房间增色不少。

enDef: very big in size or in amount

example.en: an enormous bunch of flowers
example.cn: 巨大的花束

enDef: to improve the quality of something, especially by adding things to it

example.en: Add fertilizer to enrich the soil.
example.cn: 施上肥料使土壤肥沃。

example.en: Class enrollment, where each student has all of the course schedule selections, each student having his own bucket in the CGTT.
example.cn: 班级入学，每个学生都有所有的课程安排选择，每个学生都将自己的选择放在 CGTT 中。

enDef: to make certain that something will happen properly

example.en: facilities to ensure the safety of cyclists
example.cn: 确保骑车人安全的设施

enDef: amusing and interesting

example.en: Children’s TV nowadays is much more entertaining.
example.cn: 如今的儿童电视节目要比过去有趣多了。

enDef: having the same value, purpose, job etc as a person or thing of a different kind

example.en: I had no dollars, but offered him an equivalent amount of sterling.
example.cn: 我没有美金，但给了他等值的英镑。

enDef: If there is equivalence between two things, they have the same use, function, size, or value

example.en: ...the equivalence of science and rationality.
example.cn: ...科学和理性的相等。

enDef: a period of time in history that is known for a particular event, or for particular qualities

example.en: His death marked the end of an era.
example.cn: 他的去世标志着一个时代的终结。

enDef: used when stating the most basic facts about something

example.en: Ballet is essentially a middle-class interest.
example.cn: 芭蕾舞基本上是中产阶级感兴趣的东西。

enDef: the act of starting an organization, relationship, or system
a feeling of respect for someone, or a good opinion of someone

example.en: After that, we could go for esteem and respect.
example.cn: 而再往上，我们可能需要自尊和尊重。

enDef: to try to judge the value, size, speed, cost etc of something, without calculating it exactly

example.en: Try to estimate how many steps it will take to get to a close object.
example.cn: 估计一下需要多少步才能到达一个近距目标。

enDef: something that is very bad or harmful

example.en: She wanted to protect her children from the evils of the outside world.
example.cn: 她想保护她的孩子不受外界的不良影响。

enDef: to develop and change gradually over a long period of time

example.en: The school has evolved its own style of teaching.
example.cn: 学校逐步形成了自己的教学风格。

enDef: to make something seem better, larger, worse etc than it really is

example.en: I couldn’t sleep for three days – I’m not exaggerating.
example.cn: 我三天没睡觉了——一点不夸张。

enDef: something or someone that is not included in a general statement or does not follow a rule or pattern

example.en: It’s been cold, but today’s an exception.
example.cn: 天气一直寒冷，但今天是个例外。

enDef: much more than is reasonable or necessary

example.en: his excessive drinking
example.cn: 他的酗酒

enDef: to deliberately not include something

example.en: a special diet that excludes dairy products
example.cn: 不包含奶制品的特别食谱

enDef: a loud sound and the energy produced by something such as a bomb bursting into small pieces

example.en: We heard a loud explosion.
example.cn: 我们听到一声巨大的爆炸声。

enDef: when someone is in a situation where they are not protected from something dangerous or unpleasant

example.en: Exposure to lead is known to damage the brains of young children.
example.cn: 已知接触铅会损害幼童的大脑。

example.en: Moreover, it offers the expressiveness which helps to “simplify complex tasks”.
example.cn: 此外，它更具表现力，这有助于“简化复杂任务”。

enDef: extracurricular activities are not part of the course that a student is doing at a school or college

example.en: Each child had participated in extracurricular activities at school.
example.cn: 每个孩子都参加了学校的课外活动。

enDef: continuing for ever, even after someone has died

example.en: everlasting fame
example.cn: 永久的名声

enDef: a larger amount of something than is allowed or needed

example.en: After you apply the oil, wait 20 minutes before wiping off any excess.
example.cn: 涂上油以后，等20分钟再擦掉多余部分。

enDef: relating to the way in which plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time

example.en: the evolutionary development of birds
example.cn: 鸟类的进化过程

enDef: to make someone feel extremely tired

example.en: A full day’s teaching exhausts me.
example.cn: 讲一整天课令我精疲力竭。

example.en: The new rocket was extensively tested and debugged by the army.
example.cn: 这种新式火箭由军方进行了广泛的测试和调试。

enDef: extremely important and necessary

example.en: Window locks are fairly cheap and absolutely essential.
example.cn: 窗锁相当便宜，绝对有必要安装。

enDef: to put someone or something in danger of being hurt, damaged, or destroyed

example.en: Smoking during pregnancy endangers your baby’s life.
example.cn: 孕期吸烟会危及胎儿生命。

cn: 使具有权利，使具有资格
enDef: to give someone the official right to do or have something

example.en: If the warranty is limited, the terms may entitle you to a replacement or refund.
example.cn: 如果保修单有限制，这些条款可让你有权换货或退款。

enDef: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity to do it

example.en: The new test should enable doctors to detect the disease early.
example.cn: 新的检验使医生能在早期发现该种疾病。

enDef: someone who has been forced to live in exile

example.en: political exiles
example.cn: 政治流亡者

enDef: one part or feature of a whole system, plan, piece of work etc, especially one that is basic or important

example.en: Business and management elements are built into the course.
example.cn: 本课程加入了商务和管理方面的内容。

enDef: a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is

example.en: We need to carry out a proper evaluation of the new system.
example.cn: 我们要对新系统进行合理的评估。

example.en: You have to grant us control explicitly.
example.cn: 你们必须允许我们明确地控制。

enDef: to appear or come out from somewhere

example.en: The flowers emerge in the spring.
example.cn: 花儿在春天开放。

enDef: very serious and sincere

example.en: a rather earnest young man
example.cn: 相当认真的一个年轻人

enDef: a sound that you hear again after a loud noise, because it was made near something such as a wall

example.en: Her scream was followed by a loud echo.
example.cn: 她的尖叫声过后是响亮的回声。

enDef: relating to trade, in-dustry, and the management of money

example.en: Economic growth is slow.
example.cn: 经济增长缓慢。

enDef: using money, time, goods etc carefully and without wasting any

example.en: A small car is more economical to run.
example.cn: 开小型汽车比较省油。

enDef: the system by which a country’s money and goods are produced and used, or a country considered in this way

example.en: a successful economy
example.cn: 发展成功的经济

enDef: successful, and working in the way that was intended

example.en: The cheaper drugs are just as effective in treating arthritis.
example.cn: 较便宜的药品对治疗关节炎同样有效。

enDef: the quality of doing something well and effectively, without wasting time, money, or energy

example.en: considerable advancements in energy efficiency
example.cn: 能源效率的显著提高

enDef: if someone or something is efficient, they work well without wasting time, money, or energy

example.en: a very efficient secretary
example.cn: 效率高的秘书

enDef: having a lot of small parts or details put together in a complicated way

example.en: pure silks embroidered with elaborate patterns
example.cn: 绣有精美图案的真丝衣服

enDef: Elastic is a rubber material that stretches when you pull it and returns to its original size and shape when you let it go. Elastic is often used in clothes to make them fit tightly, for example, around the waist.

example.en: Make a mask with long ears and attach a piece of elastic to go around the back of the head.
example.cn: 做一个带长耳朵的面具，安上一条松紧带绕过后脑。

enDef: when people vote to choose someone for an official position

example.en: The Labour Party won the 2001 election by a huge majority.
example.cn: 工党在2001年选举中以巨大优势获胜。

enDef: a very small piece of matter with a negative electrical charge that moves around the nucleus(= central part ) of an atom

example.en: Most things are balanced - with equal numbers of electrons and protons.
example.cn: 大部分物体都是电荷平衡的——含等量的电子和质子。

enDef: the study or industry of making equipment, such as computers and televisions, that work electronically

example.en: an electronics engineer
example.cn: 电子工程师

enDef: the removal or destruction of something

example.en: Breast-feeding is as natural as sex or elimination or any other bodily function.
example.cn: 母乳哺养是天生的，就像性交、排泄或者其他任何身体功能一样。

enDef: in, at, or to another place

example.en: She is becoming famous in Australia and elsewhere.
example.cn: 她在澳大利亚和其他地方渐渐出名了。

enDef: special attention or importance

example.en: a change of emphasis in government policy
example.cn: 政府政策重心的变化

enDef: someone who is paid to work for someone else

example.en: a government employee
example.cn: 政府雇员

enDef: a person, company, or organization that employs people

example.en: The shoe factory is the largest employer in this area.
example.cn: 这家制鞋厂是本地区最大的雇主。

enDef: the condition of having a paid job

example.en: She was offered employment in the sales office.
example.cn: 她获聘在销售部工作。

enDef: to put something inside an envelope as well as a letter

example.en: Please enclose a cheque with your order.
example.cn: 请随订单附上支票。

enDef: to experience something, especially problems or opposition

example.en: The doctor had encountered several similar cases in the past.
example.cn: 那位医生过去曾碰到过好几个类似病例。

enDef: to make people obey a rule or law

example.en: Parking restrictions will be strictly enforced.
example.cn: 停车限制将会严格执行。

enDef: the work involved in designing and building roads, bridges, machines etc

example.en: Their inventions have contributed to the development of electrical engineering.
example.cn: 他们的发明有助于电气工程学的发展。

enDef: a man from England

example.en: He was the only Englishman present.
example.cn: 他是在场的唯一一名英国人。

enDef: to invite people to your home for a meal, party etc, or to take your company’s customers somewhere to have a meal, drinks etc

example.en: Mark usually does the cooking when we entertain.
example.cn: 我们招待客人时通常都是马克下厨。

enDef: a strong feeling of interest and enjoyment about something and an eagerness to be involved in it

example.en: Gillian and Darren greeted the speakers with great enthusiasm.
example.cn: 吉利恩和达伦非常热情地接待了演讲者。

enDef: a statement in mathematics that shows that two amounts or totals are equal

example.en: In the equation 2x + 1 = 7, what is x?
example.cn: 在方程式2x+1=7中，x的值为多少？

enDef: to build something such as a building or wall

example.en: an imposing town hall, erected in 1892
example.cn: 一座气势宏伟的市政厅，建于1892年

enDef: if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas

example.en: Most of the water had evaporated.
example.cn: 大部分的水都蒸发了。

enDef: the night or day before an important day

example.en: We’re arriving on Christmas Eve.
example.cn: 我们将在平安夜到达。

enDef: a spoken or written test of knowledge, especially an important one

example.en: The examination results will be announced in September.
example.cn: 考试成绩将于9月公布。

enDef: to be more than a particular number or amount

example.en: Working hours must not exceed 42 hours a week.
example.cn: 工作时间每周不得超过42小时。

enDef: extremely

example.en: Thank you. You’ve been exceedingly kind.
example.cn: 谢谢，你真是太好了。

enDef: making you feel excited

example.en: an exciting discovery
example.cn: 激动人心的发现

enDef: to say something suddenly and loudly because you are surprised, angry, or excited

example.en: ‘No!’ she exclaimed in shock.
example.cn: “不！”她惊呼道。

example.en: These are not involved as exclusively as ministers in "soul-work," but they certainly cultivate the inner life more than the third group.
example.cn: 他们虽不像牧师那样专门做“灵魂方面的工作”，但是肯定比第三群体更注重于建造人类的生命。

enDef: a short journey arranged so that a group of people can visit a place, especially while they are on holiday

example.en: a shopping excursion
example.cn: 购物游

enDef: to kill someone, especially legally as a punishment

example.en: 13 people were summarily executed (= killed without any trial or legal process ) by the guerrillas.
example.cn: 有13人被游击队员就地处决。

enDef: relating to the job of managing a business or organization and making decisions

example.en: a commission with executive powers
example.cn: 有执行权的委员会

enDef: to use your power, influence etc in order to make something happen

example.en: They exerted considerable influence within the school.
example.cn: 他们在校内施加了很大的影响力。

enDef: to show something in a public place so that people can go to see it

example.en: Her paintings have been exhibited all over the world.
example.cn: 她的绘画作品在世界各地展出。

enDef: when something increases in size, range, amount etc

example.en: The industry underwent a period of rapid expansion.
example.cn: 该产业经历了一轮快速扩张。

enDef: used for, relating to, or resulting from experiments

example.en: experimental animals
example.cn: 用于实验的动物

enDef: a substance that can cause an explosion

example.en: ...one-hundred-and-fifty pounds of Semtex explosive.
example.cn: …150磅的塞姆汀塑料炸药。

enDef: to continue for a longer period of time, or to make something last longer

example.en: Management have agreed to extend the deadline.
example.cn: 管理层已同意延长最后期限。

enDef: large in size, amount, or degree

example.en: The house stands in extensive grounds.
example.cn: 这栋房子占地面积很大。

enDef: on the outside of something

example.en: The exterior walls need a new coat of paint.
example.cn: 外墙需要刷新漆了。

enDef: relating to the outside of something or of a person’s body

example.en: the external appearance of the building
example.cn: 大楼的外观

cn: 土地， 住宅区， 地产； 财产， 遗产； 庄园， 种植园
enDef: a large area of land in the country, usually with one large house on it and one owner

example.en: a country estate
example.cn: 乡村的庄园

enDef: used as a polite way of saying that someone is old or becoming old

example.en: a well-dressed elderly woman
example.cn: 穿着考究的老妇人

cn: 选举的，有选举权的；可任意选择的
enDef: an elective position or organization is one for which there is an election

example.en: the 34 elective seats in the National Assembly
example.cn: 国民议会中的34个选举席位

example.en: The company voted to enfranchise its 120 women members.
example.cn: 公司投票决定给予其120名女员工选举权。

cn: 装入胶囊； 压缩； 总结， 概述
enDef: to express or show something in a short way

example.en: The words of the song neatly encapsulate the mood of the country at that time.
example.cn: 这首歌的歌词言简意赅地表现出国家当时的氛围。

cn: 可延伸的， 可展开的， 可扩张的
enDef: Something that is extendable can be made longer

example.en: These were hung in place with extendable rods.
example.cn: 这些是用可延长的杆挂到位的。

cn: 大批离去， 成群外出
enDef: If there is an exodus of people from a place, a lot of people leave that place at the same time

example.en: The medical system is facing collapse because of an exodus of doctors.
example.cn: 由于医生大批离去，该医疗体系正面临崩溃。

enDef: relating to principles of what is right and wrong

example.en: The president must have the highest ethical standards.
example.cn: 总统必须具备最高的道德水准。

example.en: ethereal beauty
example.cn: 超凡的美丽

enDef: to breathe air, smoke etc out of your mouth

example.en: Take a deep breath, then exhale slowly.
example.cn: 深吸一口气，然后慢慢呼出。

example.en: The amount or rate of emission or ejection.
example.cn: 排放量流量、流速，或排出量，排出的速度。

cn: 开发的， 利用的； 剥削的
enDef: taking as much as possible from someone or something and giving very little in return

example.en: the exploitative nature of multinational companies
example.cn: 跨国公司的剥削本质

enDef: to explain something that is difficult to understand by providing more information

example.en: The full picture has not yet been elucidated.
example.cn: 详细情况还没有解释清楚。

cn: 开采， 开发； 剥削， 榨取； 自私的利用
enDef: a situation in which you treat someone unfairly by asking them to do things for you, but give them very little in return – used to show disapproval

cn: 精心之作； 详尽阐述
谜， 谜一样的人或事

example.en: The neighbours regarded him as something of an enigma.
example.cn: 邻居们把他当成谜一样的人。

enDef: the wide part of a river where it goes into the sea

example.en: the Thames estuary
example.cn: 泰晤士河河口

cn: 包含； 包围； 环绕
enDef: to include a wide range of ideas, subjects, etc

example.en: The study encompasses the social, political, and economic aspects of the situation.
example.cn: 这项研究涵盖了这一局势的社会、政治和经济三方面。

enDef: to be impossible to forget

example.en: Your wedding ring can be engraved with a personal inscription at no extra cost.
example.cn: 你的结婚戒指可以刻上个人题字不另收费。

enDef: if something engrosses you, it interests you so much that you do not notice anything else

example.en: The scene was stunning, and for a time engrossed all our attention.
example.cn: 景色非常美丽，一时间把我们都完全吸引住了。

enDef: if a scientist or archaeologist excavates an area of land, they dig carefully to find ancient objects, bones etc

example.en: Schliemann excavated the ancient city of Troy.
example.cn: 谢里曼发掘出特洛伊古城。

enDef: to twist two things together or to wind one thing around another

example.en: They walked together with their arms entwined.
example.cn: 他们挽着胳膊一起走。

enDef: the solid waste material that you get rid of through your bowels

example.en: The cage smelled of excrement.
example.cn: 这个笼子闻起来有粪便味。

enDef: to make someone feel very excited and happy
to try very hard to persuade someone to do something

example.en: Kennedy exhorted his listeners to turn away from violence.
example.cn: 肯尼迪劝告他的听众要远离暴力。

example.en: If a volcanic eruption wipes out all of the plain mice, the island will be repopulated by striped mice.
example.cn: 假设一次火山爆发消灭了所有的普通老鼠，那么这个小岛将是斑纹鼠的天下。

cn: 把译成电码， 把…编码
enDef: to put a message or other information into code

example.en: The two parties encode confidential data in a form that is not directly readable by the other party.
example.cn: 双方把机密数据写成一种不能被对方直接读懂的密码。

cn: 探测的； 勘探的； 探索的
enDef: done in order to find out more about something

example.en: He’s going to have exploratory surgery on his knee.
example.cn: 他的膝盖要做探查性手术。

cn: 挖掘， 发掘； 出土文物

example.en: Blue flags define the excavation perimeter, while yellow ones mark the location of fossils or stone tools.
example.cn: 蓝旗用来显示发掘地的周长，而黄旗用来标明发掘出化石或石制工具的地点。

enDef: the solid or liquid waste material that people and animals produce and get rid of from their bodies

example.en: The excreta of humans and land animals contain soluble refractory organic matter.
example.cn: 人和陆生动物排泄物含有可溶的难处理有机物质。

cn: 保留头衔而退休的， 荣誉退休的
enDef: Emeritus is used with a professional title to indicate that the person bearing it has retired but keeps the title as an honour

example.en: ...emeritus professor of physics.
example.cn: ...物理学荣誉教授。

enDef: the end of a period of time during which an official document can legally be used, or the end of a period of authority

example.en: Check the expiry date on your passport.
example.cn: 看一下你的护照什么时候到期。

example.en: This action externally appears like the discharge of a capacitor.
example.cn: 这一作用从外表上看来像电容器的放电现象。

cn: 可原谅的； 可谅解的； 可容许的
enDef: behaviour that is excusable can be forgiven

example.en: an excusable reaction of anger
example.cn: 情有可原的恼怒反应

enDef: a feeling of being happy, excited, and full of energy

example.en: It might be the exhilaration of that potent cordial, which is distilled only in the furnace-glow of earnest and long-continued thought.
example.cn: 那力量可能是潜在热情的兴奋表现，是从长期不断的诚挚思想的熔炉中蒸馏出来的。

enDef: a circular movement of water, wind, dust etc

example.en: The racing river caused swirling eddies.
example.cn: 湍急的河水形成了许多漩涡。

cn: 筑堤； 堤岸， 路基
enDef: a wide wall of earth or stones built to stop water from flooding an area, or to support a road or railway

example.en: They climbed a steep embankment.
example.cn: 他们爬上了一个陡峭的堤岸。

enDef: the process of arranging to join a school, university, course etc

example.en: Enrolment will take place in September.
example.cn: 注册将于9月进行。

enDef: An ensemble is a group of musicians, actors, or dancers who regularly perform together

example.en: ...an ensemble of young musicians.
example.cn: …一个由年轻音乐家组成的乐团。

enDef: to make something become twisted and caught in a rope, net etc

example.en: The blade of the oar had entangled itself with the strap of her bag.
example.cn: 桨叶和她包的带子紧紧缠在了一起。

enDef: a chemical substance that is produced in a plant or animal, and helps chemical changes to take place in the plant or animal

example.en: It is believed that it inhibits an enzyme that promotes cell proliferation in tumours.
example.cn: 据信它能抑制一种能在肿瘤中促进细胞增殖的酶的生成。

enDef: an exorbitant price, amount of money etc is much higher than it should be

example.en: Exorbitant housing prices have created an acute shortage of affordable housing for the poor.
example.cn: 过高的房价使穷人负担得起的房源严重短缺。

enDef: helping you to deal with a problem quickly and effectively although sometimes in a way that is not morally right

example.en: This solution is politically expedient but may well cause long-term problems.
example.cn: 这种解决方法是政治上的权宜之计，但会引起长远的问题。

enDef: the act of forcing someone to leave a place

example.en: The headmaster threatened the boys with expulsion.
example.cn: 校长警告这几名男生说要开除他们。

enDef: Entrepreneurial means having the qualities that are needed to succeed as an entrepreneur

example.en: ...her prodigious entrepreneurial flair.
example.cn: …她惊人的创业天赋。

cn: 征募； 从军， 参军； 谋取
enDef: to persuade someone to help you to do something

cn: 委托， 交付， 托付
enDef: to make someone responsible for doing something important, or for taking care of someone

example.en: He entrusted his cash to a business partner for investment in a series of projects.
example.cn: 他把现款委托给一个生意合伙人投资一系列项目。

cn: 侵入， 侵占， 侵犯； 侵蚀， 蚕食
enDef: to gradually take more of someone’s time, possessions, rights etc than you should

example.en: The new institutions do not encroach on political power.
example.cn: 这些新机构没有侵犯到政治权力。

cn: 挤出， 推出， 挤压
enDef: Extrusion is the act or process of extruding something
To entice someone to go somewhere or to do something means to try to persuade them to go to that place or to do that thing

example.en: They'll entice thousands of doctors to move from the cities to the rural areas by paying them better salaries.
example.cn: 他们将通过支付更高的薪水怂恿成千上万的医生从城市迁往农村。

cn: 与…竞争， 赶上； 仿真， 模仿
enDef: to do something or behave in the same way as someone else, especially because you admire them

example.en: He hoped to emulate the success of Wilder.
example.cn: 他希望效仿怀尔德的成功。

enDef: not harmful to the environment

example.en: eco-friendly products
example.cn: 对环境无害的产品

cn: 性格外向的人； 爱交际的人
enDef: someone who is active and confident, and who enjoys spending time with other people

example.en: Her sister was always more of an extrovert.
example.cn: 她妹妹总是更外向些。

cn: 陶冶， 教化； 启发， 启迪
enDef: to improve the morality, intellect, etc, of, esp by instruction

cn: 赞颂， 赞美， 颂扬
enDef: to praise something very much

example.en: Now experts are extolling the virtues of the humble potato.
example.cn: 现在专家们在颂扬粗陋的马铃薯的种种好处。

cn: 包揽无遗的， 彻底的， 详尽的
enDef: extremely thorough and complete

example.en: an exhaustive investigation
example.cn: 彻底的调查

enDef: extreme tiredness

example.en: Sheer exhaustion forced him to give up.
example.cn: 他疲惫不堪，只好放弃。

cn: 奴役， 征服， 使受控制
enDef: if something enslaves you, it completely controls your life and your actions

example.en: She seemed enslaved by hatred.
example.cn: 她似乎被仇恨所左右。

cn: 偶然发生的， 不定期的； 由许多片段组成的， 松散的
enDef: something that is episodic happens from time to time and then stops for a while, rather than happening all the time

example.en: his episodic involvement in politics
example.cn: 他对政治的偶尔参与

cn: 可耗尽的， 会枯竭的

example.en: Your willpower is an exhaustible supply, so don't force yourself to finish tasks if you don't have to.
example.cn: 你的意志力是会枯竭的，所以如果没有必要，不要强迫自己完成任务。

enDef: to separate and live apart from (one's spouse)

example.en: he is estranged from his wife

enDef: extremely happy and excited, especially because of something that has happened or is going to happen

example.en: He felt elated and mildly drunk.
example.cn: 他感到欢欣鼓舞，而且喝得有点醉了。

enDef: existing or popular for only a short time

example.en: Fashion is by nature ephemeral.
example.cn: 从本质上说，时尚不过是一时的潮流。

enDef: treating all people in a fair and equal way

example.en: an equitable distribution of food supplies
example.cn: 所供应食品的合理分配

cn: 公平；公正；无固定利息的股票
enDef: a situation in which all people are treated equally and no one has an unfair advantage

example.en: a society run on the principles of equity and justice
example.cn: 以公平、正义为原则的社会

enDef: if you are equivocal, you are deliberately unclear in the way that you give information or your opinion

example.en: His answer was equivocal.
example.cn: 他的回答模棱两可。

cn: 古怪的，反复无常的，不稳定的
enDef: something that is erratic does not follow any pattern or plan but happens in a way that is not regular

example.en: His breathing was becoming erratic.
example.cn: 他的呼吸越来越不均匀。

enDef: to kill large numbers of people or animals of a particular type so that they no longer exist

example.en: Staff use the poison to exterminate moles and rabbits.
example.cn: 员工用毒药来消灭鼹鼠和野兔。

enDef: to illegally force someone to give you something, especially money, by threatening them

example.en: Corrupt government officials were extorting money from him.
example.cn: 腐败的政府官员那时正向他勒索钱财。

enDef: If you are exuberant, you are full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness

example.en: So the exuberant young girl with dark hair and blue eyes decided to become a screen actress.
example.cn: 因此，这个充满活力的年轻黑发碧眼女孩决定成为一名荧屏演员。

enDef: to cover or surround something completely

example.en: When nuclear fuel is manufactured it is encased in metal cans.
example.cn: 核燃料生产出来时被装在金属罐中。

enDef: to act in a play, story etc

example.en: a drama enacted on a darkened stage
example.cn: 在灯光暗淡的舞台上演的戏剧

cn: 脾气随和的， 心平气和的； 随便的
enDef: not easily upset, annoyed, or worried

example.en: Her easy-going nature made her popular.
example.cn: 她生性随和，人缘很好。

cn: 难懂的， 难捉摸的； 易忘的
enDef: an elusive result is difficult to achieve

example.en: She enjoys a firm reputation in this country but wider international success has been elusive.
example.cn: 她在这个国家享有稳固的声誉，但却一直难以在国际上取得更大的成功。

enDef: An enhancer is a substance or a device that makes a particular thing look, taste, or feel better

example.en: Cinnamon is an excellent flavour enhancer.
example.cn: 肉桂是一种绝佳的提味料。

enDef: a large long pile of earth, used in the past to stop attacks

example.en: To pipe installation is complete and experience the qualified, conducted only after backfill earthwork.
example.cn: 待涵管道安装完成并经验收合格后，方可进行土方回填。

enDef: a common type of long thin brown worm that lives in soil

example.en: That chick pecks out an earthworm from the earth.
example.cn: 那只小鸡从土里啄出一条蚯蚓。
